title: Chronic kidney disease with impaired kidney function
summary: CKD with reduced glomerular filtration rate or low serum albumin/elevated proteinuria, plus one of: severe anemia, atherosclerotic renovascular disease, hyperparathyroidism, peripheral neuropathy, or fluid overload, persisting ≥90 days within 12-month period.

children.criterion: Reduced kidney function: low GFR/CrCl/serum creatinine, OR low serum albumin with proteinuria
Serum creatinine ≥4 mg/dL, OR creatinine clearance ≤20 mL/min, OR estimated GFR ≤20 mL/min/1.73m², on at least two evaluations at least 90 days apart within 12-month period
Serum albumin ≤3.0 g/dL with proteinuria of 3.5 g/24 hrs (or ACR 3500 mg/g), on at least two evaluations 90 days apart in 12-month period
